reason: Layout and ABI overhead are real, but no quantified broad gain supports a whole-runtime migration or explains the multiplicative gap.

layout.scope: Exact retained VmError/Value layout; isolated ABI probe, not a runtime performance measurement

counts_scope: Exact saved analysis call edges into source-identified core VM/stdlib unit Result functions; not exhaustive, not inclusive instruction sums.

illustrative_projection.scope: Illustrative arithmetic only, not measured gain or global upper bound

limitations: A smaller return type alone is not a speedup proof.
A first boxed inline allocation probe adds a hot stack prologue; outlining the cold constructor removes it.
Actual layout uses retained release-library VmError and Value; the private ColdResult type was not claimed to be directly measured.
Successful whole-application behavior and native performance need a real A/B before any source migration.
